Delicious bbq at the heart of Da Lat night market
Dec 2023 • Couples
First time trying and surprising its delicious. You can order from the touch screen and they have English language too. The price is not expensive and reasonable.. their services are pretty good and they will help to put your meat into the bbq tray, regularly check the meat and also cut for you. Please note that it is pretty warm inside. Not sure if they have aircon or not but they are making use of the cold air from outside. Luckily I am sitting very close to the exit door.

Overall, highly recommended! The location is right in the middle of the night market. After your meal, you can turn right to L'angfarm store where you can buy many snack or you can walk around the night market.

Unfortunately the evening was slightly dampened by the screaming kids playing in the play area in the restaurant and oblivious parents not sorting their children out. If it wasn't for this it would have been 5*, the staff tried their best to quiet the kids. But it would have been nice if there was a door between the play area and the restaurant. 

Fabulous restaurant though, would go again!

Korean Food in Dalat
Nov 2019 • Friends
Never thought that I would eat Korean food in Vietnam but it was so close to Dalat Market that we decided to give it a try.

They have an English menu with pictures which made ordering so much easier. We ordered some beef and pork and the staff cooked it for us. The service was good.

The restaurant was clean and the place was popular with the locals especially the young adults. 

The pancakes and the rice rolls were good. For the 4 of us, the bill came up to about 500K vnd which we thought was a very fair price.

While exploring the town, we saw 2 other branches. I would recommend the restaurant for it's good service and food.
